DELETE /v1/scoring_models/{model_id}.note: FinicClient.delete_scoring_model is exposed; the toolkit never selects it by default because it cannot be undone.

DELETE /v1/scoring_models/{model_id}/que.note: FinicClient.remove_question removes one question and reads the updated model.

GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}.note: Job status is exposed with sync and async clients.

GET /v1/scoring_models.note: FinicClient.list_scoring_models reads the documented scoring_models listing.

GET /v1/scoring_models/{model_id}.note: FinicClient.get_scoring_model reads the model with its questions, sources and weights.

PATCH /v1/scoring_models/{model_id}.note: FinicClient.update_scoring_model renames, re-states criteria, and archives or unarchives.

POST /v1/ask.note: FinicClient.decide and FinicClassifier call /v1/ask directly with the documented typed question and answer contract.

POST /v1/calibrate.note: FinicClient.calibrate sends labeled records with add_questions and remove_questions, and reads job_id and rows.

POST /v1/score.note: FinicClient.score and FinicScorer send the documented JSON fields, including include_questions, and parse the returned questions.

POST /v1/scoring_models.note: FinicClient.create_scoring_model creates from criteria alone or from labeled records, and reads both the 201 and 202 shapes.

POST /v1/scoring_models/{model_id}/quest.note: FinicClient.add_questions adds up to 20 questions and reads the model with its added list.
